mode.title: Mode
mode.description: fear_greed = the Fear & Greed Index over time (one row per day). overview = a single market snapshot (market cap, dominance, volume, and the current Fear & Greed reading). trending = the coins trending right now.

fearGreedDays.title: Days of history (fear_greed mode)
fearGreedDays.description: How many days of Fear & Greed Index history to return.

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on rows returned. Controls total cost.
